{{Quote|Oh, and I recommend the Merenzane Gold in the bar&mdash;subtle, sweet, expensive.|Leb Slesher|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Merenzane Gold''' was an expensive [[Alcohol/Legends|liquor]], commonly selling for more than one hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a bottle. [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]] claimed to serve it at the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]]. However, one of his regular customers, [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]], described Wuher's Merenzane Gold as a poor imitation which came from "bottles that once, eons ago, were looked at hard by a man who heard of Merenzane!"

Wuher did have a bottle of the genuine article, however. He once poured Kardue'sai'Malloc a drink from it, to welcome him back to the bar after he had recovered from a severe beating.

==Behind the scenes==
In the comic [[Legacy (2006) 37|''Legacy'' (2006) 37]], Merenzane Gold was erroneously referred to as "Merazane Gold". Then in the following issue Merenzane Gold was mentioned again, where it was spelled correctly.
